title: iNOB — imaging neuroscience outside the brain: whole-body forward modelling and sensor planning for non-invasive recording of peripheral and autonomic nerves
description: A whole-body forward-modelling and sensor-planning package for non-invasive OPM-MEG and surface-EEG recording of peripheral and autonomic nerves. Atlas meshes to a multi-tissue tetrahedral FEM to calibrated MEG and EEG leadfields via DUNEuro, with noise, SNR, trials-to-detect and sensor-placement analyses, a CLI and a browser GUI.
notes: Anatomical meshes under data/ are BodyParts3D derivatives, CC BY-SA 2.1 JP (see LICENSE-DATA); the MIT licence covers the code only.
